research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, learn how all 109 writable facilities change future system-wide cumulative TFV, screen all 109 facilities, optimize a TrainFit-supported dynamic active set, execute only a confidently beneficial first 10-minute target, then re-observe

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete reference/candidate H360 actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.selection: explicit HOLD/action training plus a rainfall-disjoint Development minimum-predicted-improvement threshold
core_pipeline.step3: screen all 109 facilities, choose a dynamic active set from learned first-move value, optimize only inside TrainFit action support, require the calibrated improvement threshold, execute first 10 minutes, repeat
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label generator and authoritative control evaluation truth; never the online candidate evaluator

time_contract.terminal_tail: hold the final H120 target through H360

action_contract.reason: unrestricted 12x109 optimisation can exploit unsupported surrogate regions; current Step3 dynamically screens all 109 then optimizes an empirically supported sparse active set
action_contract.engineering_bounds: per-facility physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.support_bounds: per-facility first-move and sequence q95 setting differences derived from TrainFit only

step2_current.primary_target: authoritative exact SWMM delta TFV relative to same-prefix reference
step2_current.model: shared pairwise V(candidate)-V(reference), decomposed into 109 facility value differences plus multi-facility interaction value difference
step2_current.reference_representation: complete H360 reference and candidate sequences through the same value network
step2_current.zero_action_contract: candidate == reference -> exact predicted delta TFV zero
step2_current.antisymmetry_contract: swapping candidate/reference negates predicted delta exactly
step2_current.main_stage: exact single-facility branches train 109 facility main-value differences
step2_current.selection_stage: low-learning-rate late-representation/head fine-tuning on all TrainFit branches with explicit HOLD/action sign and oracle-choice losses
step2_current.harmful_false_benefit_asymmetry: harmful actions receive greater HOLD/action loss weight because false-beneficial predictions can trigger real control while missed benefit falls back to HOLD
step2_current.dev_group_counts: 112 D2 FIT + 112 D3 FIT + 33 D4 FIT; audit on 32 D2 holdout + 32 D3 holdout + 15 D4 AUDIT
step2_current.109_facility_learning_gate: full DEV fails closed unless all 109 facilities have exact single-facility TrainFit evidence
step2_current.action_support_artifact: checkpoint.action_support stores per-facility first-move/sequence q95 support, joint changed-facility quantiles, facility coverage, and TrainFit delta-TFV range

selection_current.calibration_split: existing D3 internal holdout split again by rainfall group into disjoint calibration/audit sets
selection_current.method: choose the minimum predicted improvement threshold lexicographically: minimize harmful selections, then false actions on oracle-HOLD groups, then mean authoritative selected delta TFV, regret, and finally prefer useful action rate
selection_current.previous_scalar_margin_status: ablation/history only; with n=16 and alpha=0.10 its finite-sample rank equals the sample maximum and was empirically overconservative

step3_current.screening: evaluate first-move up/down probes for all 109 facilities inside per-facility TrainFit first-move q95 support
step3_current.active_set: dynamic top learned facilities; default count is TrainFit joint changed-facility median
step3_current.optimization: bounded L-BFGS-B only for the dynamic active set across 12 free 10-minute blocks
step3_current.trust_region: all optimized targets remain inside per-facility TrainFit q95 action support and physical/rate bounds
step3_current.admission: execute optimized action only when predicted improvement exceeds the calibrated D3 HOLD-reference threshold; otherwise HOLD
step3_current.execute: first 10-minute target only; re-observe before the next decision
step3_current.solver_only_gate: must screen 109/109, have zero support/engineering violations, complete inside the control period, and select at least one action before authoritative SWMM probes

data_boundaries.D2: primary single-facility attribution and long-duration action support
data_boundaries.D3: HOLD-reference temporal/joint supervision and HOLD-reference selection calibration/audit
data_boundaries.D4_FIT: Sparse-RBC-reference local first-move training and Development stress data
data_boundaries.D4_AUDIT: untouched Development audit only; excluded from model training, target scaling, support derivation and selection calibration

promotion_rule: first prove selection-aware Step2 retains useful held-out ordering while reducing harmful raw selections; then calibrate the HOLD threshold; then pass the 109-facility screened trust-region Step3 solver audit; only then run a small authoritative SWMM first-move/closed-loop probe
